source: distinct current and reference labeled evaluation windows
definition: Brier score; ten-bin expected calibration error; per-bin mean probability and observed frequency; drift=max absolute change in Brier or ECE
thresholds: CALIBRATED: Brier<=0.10; ECE<=0.05; drift<=0.05 | ACCEPTABLE: Brier<=0.25; ECE<=0.10; drift<=0.10 | POOR: sufficient evidence and acceptable thresholds exceeded | UNKNOWN: missing source/reference or insufficient samples
drift_definition: current-window metrics compared with a distinct reference window
limitations: thresholds are generic defaults and require independent market/regime-specific calibration before production use
